gedi_chm_reconciliation.method: Each real GEDI L2A/L2B footprint sample is matched against CHMv2 re-sampled over a 12.5m-radius disc centred on the SAME shot location (not a whole-polygon average), then paired bias/RMSE/MAE/Spearman rank correlation are computed per RH level.

attribution_rh98_minus_chm_p98.note: Positive bias = GEDI RH98 reads higher than footprint-matched CHMv2 p98. If bias is similar across quality/edge/overlap splits, the disagreement is more likely genuine structural heterogeneity or CHMv2 saturation/underestimation at tall canopy than a footprint-quality artefact; if bias concentrates in low-quality/near-edge/low-overlap shots, those specific shots should be treated as unreliable, not the whole GEDI record.

gedi_l4a_agbd.note: GEDI L4A AGBD is a MODEL-DERIVED biomass product (region x plant-functional-type calibrated), NOT field truth. Independent African-savanna validation found R^2=0.42, RMSE ~12 Mg/ha (79.5%), bias ~-36% for the stock model in some regions (sourced during this sprint's research pass) -- retained here as an independent consistency check on the inferred tree population, not as ground truth and not fed into the same likelihood as GEDI L2 structure metrics (documented dependency: L4A AGBD is itself partly derived FROM L2 RH metrics, so using both as independent likelihood terms would double-count that shared information).

structural_strata.method: k-means (k=6, plain numpy Lloyd's algorithm, 8 restarts) over standardized [height_m, cover_gt2m, ndvi, ndmi, nbr, s1_vv, s1_vh, slope_deg] at ~25-30m point-sample density (n=3646 points), then a 8-nearest-neighbour majority vote (2 passes) as a minimum-mapping-unit smoothing step. Clusters labelled post-hoc by rank of mean canopy height + cover -- DERIVED ANALYSIS STRATA, not surveyed compartments or official sub-blocks.

palsar_l_band.note: L-band backscatter from the 2024 ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 yearly mosaic -- the most recent epoch available in this collection, real but dated (not current-year). HV backscatter is known to saturate around ~90-100 Mg/ha AGB in tropical forest, so this is reported as a qualitative structural diagnostic (differentiate open/low-woody vs at-least-moderate woody structure), NOT converted to biomass directly.
